note: The OLG adequately covers the core FNS 1065.2 requirement. The 'Types of Earned Income' page states under 'Mandatory Income Averaging' that 'Households that derive their annual income in a period of time shorter than one year must have their income averaged over a twelve month period, provided the income is not received on an hourly or piecework basis.' This is the same rule as FNS 1065.2, with the same hourly/piecework exception. The OLG doesn't use the term 'contract income' but covers the concept and provides specific guidance for applicable populations (school employees, sharecroppers, farmers, self-employed). The remainder of FNS 1065.2 addresses QC reviewer procedures (correcting EW errors in reported/unreported contract income sources, AORD adjustments) which are audit methodology, not caseworker policy — the OLG is not expected to cover these.
